title: Dynatrace Access and platform token (dt0c01, dt0s..): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: dt0x01, a type letter the docs table does not define (c or s) and prefix: dt1s16 vs the documented dt0. Twin of "Dynatrace Access and platform token (dt0c01, dt0s..): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of dynatrace-token-sdk-kwarg: prefix: dt0x01, a type letter the docs table does not define (c or s). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
